content.short: Solidity Finance is a reputed smart contract auditing firm that reviews complex Solidity code.
content.description: Since its founding in 2020, Solidity Finance has become a leading smart contract auditing team known for depth of experience and robust tooling. The US-based studio combines software developers and testing specialists, including professionals with Fortune 50 experience, to deliver thorough audits at accessible pricing. Their security assessments blend static analysis, automated tooling, and meticulous manual review, enabling project teams to receive industry-leading security recommendations for hardening contracts and reducing risk.
